decisions.reason: The product has an explicit customer-value reference with quantified annual savings, which for an established German machinery maker strongly supports continuing commercialization.
A dedicated product page suggests the shredder is a serious portfolio item, and machinery firms typically keep new equipment on the market beyond the first year unless demand is clearly weak.
Although it is only mentioned briefly and may overlap with another modular plant concept, its recent launch makes near-term withdrawal unlikely while the firm tests market acceptance.

The trommel screen fits the firm's mobile waste-processing lineup, and a mature German manufacturer would usually retain such a newly launched complementary machine unless early results were clearly disappointing.
